title: The corrected copy
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
source: lore/drift_wood/_THE_COMPLETE_RUN.md (1999–2000 · deepening xix · the daily filled)
logline: A digest comes back into the rack with a spelling fixed in pen, in a careful old hand. 'Recieve' → 'receive'. The same hand as the note in November. Wood fixes it in the next week's and credits nobody. The strip credits the hand.

panels.composition: A digest in the rack, returned: a word crossed through in pen and rewritten above in a careful old hand.

image.prompt: close on a small photocopied booklet with a misspelled word crossed out in pen and corrected above in careful handwriting, black and white, no words

panels.composition: WOOD holding it. The hand. He knows the hand. BARNABY.

image.prompt: a young man holding a corrected booklet and studying the handwriting, a small dog at his feet, black and white, no words

panels.composition: Wood's pocket: the November note, unfolded beside the correction. The same hand. 'More of the boy at the counter.'

image.prompt: close on a young man's hands holding a small note and a corrected booklet side by side, the handwriting matching, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The desk at home. The next week's strip. The word spelled right. No credit. The strip draws the pen doing it, which is the credit.

image.prompt: close on a young man's pen carefully lettering a word correctly on a comic strip at a desk, black and white, no words

art.line: brush-pen, committed; black and white; xerox

notes: The reader's hand, twice. Credited by being drawn.
